# Known Issues

- Installed app must be rebuilt (`npm run dist`) to ship UI/feature changes.
- 3D views load Three.js from a CDN (needs internet).
- Mic threshold (ZOE_MIC_THRESHOLD in .env) may need tuning per environment.
